title: ONE WINDOW FRAME, CLOSE IN ONE PLACE
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): the menus still look bad, make them look like a triple-A game. UI redesign build ui6, the window frame. Every window and the pause box now sit on one plate: dark graphite with a faint grain, a thin edge, the top left corner cut off and a short amber tick on the top edge, instead of the old double frame. The window name is a header over a thin line. CLOSE was in four different places (top middle of the stash, bottom left of the Mainframe, Settings and Fashion, bottom right of the shop); it now sits at the right end of a footer bar at the foot of every station window and the stash, at one height, and at the foot of the card in the smaller windows. Nothing moved in the page order, so the controller walks every window the same way and B still closes it.
now: Every window sits on one cut corner plate with an amber tick, and CLOSE is in a footer at the bottom right of every station window and the stash.
